name: scholargraph-ai
description: Local-first research paper analyzer with citation intelligence and graph visualization.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @scholargraph/api" "npm run worker:dev -w @scholargraph/api" "npm run dev -w @scholargraph/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @scholargraph/api && npm run build -w @scholargraph/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @scholargraph/api && npm run lint -w @scholargraph/web
